title: rust-quality-orb run record, version 1
description: What one rust-quality-orb command ran, on what, and what it found: written as <report_name>.run-record.json when a command's run_record parameter is true. Fields are only ever added within version 1; a change that would break a reader gets a new schema URL.

command.description: The orb command that wrote the record.

outcome.description: passed: no findings. findings: findings failed the step. findings-reported: findings, passed because report_only is true. error: a check did not complete, so there is no verdict, and the step failed.

exit_code.description: 1 when the outcome is error or findings, else 0.

ci.description: The CI job the command ran in: a CircleCI job (from CIRCLE_BUILD_URL, CIRCLE_SHA1, CIRCLE_JOB and the project), or a GitHub Actions run (from GITHUB_SERVER_URL, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_RUN_ID, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT, GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_JOB); null elsewhere.

working_directory.description: The absolute directory the command ran in.

workspace_root.description: The root of the Cargo workspace the command checked, from cargo metadata. Paths in results are relative to it.

tool.description: The tool binary the command ran: cargo for fmt, lint, docs and msrv, else cargo-nextest, cargo-llvm-cov, cargo-hack, cargo-shear or cargo-semver-checks.

arguments.description: The arguments the tool ran with, without userinfo, query and fragment in any URL among them. For msrv and features, which run once per Rust version or target, those of the last run.

toolchain.description: The cargo and rustc on the PATH, the rustup toolchain they come from when rustup manages them, and the environment settings that change what cargo builds; null without cargo.

rustc.description: rustc -vV: the version line as version, then each key it lists (binary, commit-hash, host, release, LLVM version and so on).

rustup_toolchain.description: rustup show active-toolchain, when rustup is on the PATH.

inputs.description: The files the result depends on, by role: the workspace's Cargo.lock, its rust-toolchain.toml or rust-toolchain, each selected member's Cargo.toml, the tool's config (rustfmt.toml, clippy.toml, .config/nextest.toml), and semver_checks' baseline_root manifest.

sha256.description: null when the file doesn't exist, such as the Cargo.lock of a library that doesn't commit one.

counts.description: The command's own summary of what it found, such as lints by name, failed tests, or line coverage.

results.description: One entry per item checked, where the command checks several: each test (test), Rust version (msrv), feature combination (features), cargo-shear finding (unused_deps) or package (semver_checks). null for the others.

reports.description: Every report the command wrote, with its SHA-256.

version.description: What the binary reports as its version; empty when it reports none.

install.description: How the orb installed the binary that ran, from the record its install command left beside it. null when there is none, or when it describes another binary than the one that ran (as for a cargo that is a rustup proxy).

method.description: prebuilt: a release binary or archive (for Rust, the release's channel manifest, whose SHA-256 checksums verified each component), verified against the orb's checksum table.

asset.description: The file that was verified: the release asset, or Rust's channel manifest.

asset_sha512.description: The SHA-512 the orb's checksum table lists for it; empty when it was not verified.

targets.description: Rust: the targets whose standard library was installed besides the host's.
